Grants a stack of 'Collective Purpose' for each ally within 15 meters. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Collective Purpose grants the following benefits while at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Range
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Handling
• 0.975x?|0.95x?|0.925x?|0.9x?|0.875x? Draw Time Multiplier
• 5|10|15|20?|25? Charge Time Stat (For reference, 10 Charge Time stat is the benefit of a Charge Time Masterwork)
